sentences.text: [slightly surprised] This wedding toast started with a man drinking a stranger's bathwater.
[pause] And yes, it's named after actual toast.
You see, the English used to drop spiced toast into wine, to make cheap wine taste better.
Now, in the town of Bath, crowds watched people soak in hot public pools.
One day, a famous beauty stood in the water.
[in disbelief] A man scooped a glass of her bathwater, and drank it to her health.
So what did his drunk friend do?
He said forget the drink, he wanted the toast, and tried to jump in after her.
At least, that's how a London magazine told it.
After that, the woman everyone drank to was called the toast.
[lowering their voice] So every wedding toast copies a man drinking a stranger's bathwater.
And no, that was never romantic.
